item.title: Terragrunt Orchestration Tool for OpenTofu and Terraform Infrastructure as Code
item.description:
Terragrunt Orchestration Tool for OpenTofu and Terraform Infrastructure as Code

Terragrunt has been introduced as a flexible orchestration tool designed to help Infrastructure as Code written in OpenTofu/Terraform scale.

⚙️ Key details

  • Allows Infrastructure as Code written in OpenTofu/Terraform to scale.
  • Released under the MIT License.
